steps.label: 2267-own-set-child-omr-latex-normalize
command: (() => {if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242')throw Error('Own child only');const root=document.querySelector('#omrSlot [data-omr-code=SBSANM]'),field=[...root.querySelectorAll('math-field')].find(e=>e.dataset.placeholder==='정답 입력'),slash=String.fromCharCode(92);field.value='2'+slash+'times1'+slash+'text{행렬}';field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));if(field.value.includes(String.fromCharCode(9))||!field.value.includes(slash+'times'))throw Error('Invalid escaped math answer');return {value:field.value,codePoints:[...field.value].slice(0,9).map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)),serialized:window.omrSerializers.SBSANM.serialize(root)};})()

steps.label: 2268-own-shared-html-full-apply-confirmation
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own child without modal required');const doc=window.itemEditors.passage.getDocument(),slash=String.fromCharCode(92),root=document.querySelector('#omrSlot [data-omr-code=SBSANM]'),answer=window.omrSerializers.SBSANM.serialize(root).answer.nodes[0].allowed_answer[0].value;if(!doc.content.promptText.includes('[QA-SHARED-HTML-20261110]')||answer!=='2'+slash+'times1'+slash+'text{행렬}'||[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-webhwp-result]')].some(e=>e.value))throw Error('Expected only own HTML passage and valid OMR changes');const modal=document.getElementById('applyAllModal');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Apply modal not shown; observe without submitting')),5000);modal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='전체 반영'&&e.getClientRects().length).click();await shown;return {id:modal.id,text:modal.innerText,finalConfirmClicked:false,passage:doc,answer};})()
